Control_Objective: Prevent prohibited proprietary trades from being executed
Control_Description: Pre-trade algorithmic filters block trades on restricted instruments and covered funds

Control_Objective: Keep covered-fund and hedging exposures within approved limits
Control_Description: Daily exposure monitoring against desk limits with automated breach alerts

Control_Objective: Ensure every trade carries a documented permitted-activity rationale
Control_Description: Monthly review of trade files for missing hedging or market-making justification

Control_Objective: Ensure accurate consumer data is reported to credit bureaus
Control_Description: Automated reconciliation of furnished credit data against source loan records

Control_Objective: Ensure required consumer disclosures are complete and timely
Control_Description: Compliance review of disclosure templates before product launch and on change

Control_Objective: Track and resolve consumer complaints within regulatory timelines
Control_Description: Monthly complaint aging review with escalation of overdue cases

Control_Objective: Prevent unfair or discriminatory lending decisions
Control_Description: Automated fair-lending checks on pricing and approval decisions

Control_Objective: Detect loan servicing errors before they harm consumers
Control_Description: Quality assurance sampling of payment processing and escrow accounts

Control_Objective: Ensure separation of conflicting duties in critical systems
Control_Description: Quarterly user access attestation and segregation-of-duties conflict review

Control_Objective: Ensure regulatory data reconciles across source and reporting systems
Control_Description: Monthly reconciliation of general ledger to regulatory reporting data

Control_Objective: Ensure regulatory reports are filed accurately and on time
Control_Description: Automated regulatory calendar with filing deadline alerts

Control_Objective: Ensure accuracy of financial statements
Control_Description: Maker-checker approval and documented sign-off of close adjustments before posting

Control_Objective: Detect and remove inappropriate privileged access on financial systems
Control_Description: Monthly certification of privileged access on financial systems

Control_Objective: Prevent one user from initiating and approving the same transaction
Control_Description: System-enforced conflict rules block incompatible role combinations

Control_Objective: Ensure financial transactions are approved per delegation of authority
Control_Description: Monthly review of transactions posted without required approvals

Control_Objective: Ensure capital remains above regulatory minimums under stress
Control_Description: Quarterly capital planning and stress scenario review against minimum ratios

Control_Objective: Prevent loans above conforming loan limits
Control_Description: Automated loan limit check at origination blocks non-conforming amounts

Control_Objective: Detect unauthorized overrides of key controls
Control_Description: Monthly review of all control overrides against delegated approval authority

Control_Objective: Ensure policy exceptions are approved by the right authority
Control_Description: Senior review of exception approvals and supporting documentation

Control_Objective: Ensure control evidence and procedures are documented and current
Control_Description: Quarterly review of control documentation and evidence retention
